referenceTitle: Former John Marx Grocery Store, Buffalo, NY

rubricScores.label: Silhouette / massing
rubricScores.notes: Cornice crown + brackets project. Roof slab still softens skyline vs Marx deep cornice.

rubricScores.label: Facade rhythm
rubricScores.notes: Belts, quoins, bay grid present; still more uniform than Marx 3-bay lintel rhythm.

rubricScores.label: Opening depth
rubricScores.notes: P1: facade orientation maps local exterior onto outward normals; glass/throat into wall; lintel hoods proud. No longer surface-mounted boxes. Still shallower than Marx stone-lintel punched brick; default light (no raking) limits throat read.

rubricScores.label: Trim layering
rubricScores.notes: Cornice, belts, plinth, quoins, lintel hoods stack. Crown weight still below Marx.

rubricScores.label: Storefront / base
rubricScores.notes: Ground openings + plinth; base not as tall/distinct as Marx commercial belt (P2).

rubricScores.label: Side / rear hierarchy
rubricScores.notes: Side simpler; side openings oriented into wall face.

freeformNotes: Post V1–V5: taller base, heavier cornice, deeper openings, body belts, period material scale. Still partial vs Marx photoreal; clay silhouette is the product bar met for this plan.
